description: Build the Rule Builder tab component with visual rule creation interface, condition/action pairs with AND/OR logic, drag-and-drop priority ordering, and enable/disable toggles.
steps: Create src/components/automations/RuleBuilder.jsx - the main component for the Rule Builder tab. It displays a list of existing rules in priority order (cards showing rule name, description, trigger count, success rate, enabled toggle). Include a stats summary header showing total rules, active rules, total executions, and average success rate.

Implement drag-and-drop reordering using @dnd-kit/core and @dnd-kit/sortable (following existing patterns in the codebase - see package.json dependencies). Each rule card should be draggable to reorder priority. On reorder, update priority field and persist via updateAutomationRules.
Add enable/disable toggle per rule - a switch-style toggle on each rule card that updates the rule's enabled field and persists immediately.

Create a RuleEditorModal component (inline in same file or separate) that opens when creating/editing a rule. The modal should have: (a) Name and description fields; (b) Conditions section - condition groups connected by AND/OR logic operators. Each condition has a field selector (nurse status, document expiry, placement match, application stage), an operator (equals, not_equals, contains, greater_than, less_than, days_before, days_after), and a value input. Users can add multiple conditions and toggle the logic operator between groups; (c) Actions section - list of actions to perform when conditions are met. Each action has a type selector (Send Email, Update Status, Create Task, Add to Cohort, Trigger Alert) and type-specific parameter fields; (d) Save/Cancel buttons.
Wire RuleBuilder to AppContext via useAppContext() - use automationRules and updateAutomationRules. Add handlers for create rule, edit rule, delete rule, toggle enabled, and reorder.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build succeeds with no errors
Rule Builder tab shows list of seeded rules with priority ordering
Each rule card shows name, description, trigger count, success rate, and enabled toggle
Clicking create/edit opens a modal with condition builder (AND/OR groups) and action builder
Rules can be created, edited, deleted, enabled/disabled, and reordered - all persisted to localStorage
verification: Run npm run build and confirm exit code 0 with no errors
